info.title: PODFY Open API
info.description:
Read records (proofs of delivery and reports) and update their status from your own systems, manage your reference (asset) register, and approve refund requests and report their payout result.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request. Keys are created by a brand admin in the portal (Settings → Integrations → API keys) and shown once. `pk_live_…` keys see only production records; `pk_test_…` keys ("QA records only") see only test records from qa.podfy.app (podfy_id starting with `QA-`). A key never works in a query parameter. A missing, malformed, unknown or revoked key always gets the same `401 invalid_key`.

**Availability.** The Open API is part of PODFY Advanced. When it is not active for the brand, every call answers `403 feature_not_active`.

**Scopes.** `records:read`, `records:write`, `references:read`, `references:write`, `refunds:read`, `refunds:write`. A write scope also allows reading the same resource; nothing else is implied. Missing scope: `403 insufficient_scope`.

**Rate limits.** 600 requests per minute per key (fixed one-minute windows). Every answer for an authenticated key carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix seconds when the window ends). Above the limit: `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After` (seconds). Before the key is even looked up, a second limit of 1200 requests per minute per IP address applies (also `429 rate_limited` + `Retry-After`).

**Idempotency.** Send `Idempotency-Key: <1 to 255 visible ASCII characters>` on `POST` and `PATCH` (optional) to make a retry safe. The first request with a key runs; a repeat with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the stored status and body with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and changes nothing (no second event, webhook or audit entry). While the first request is still running a repeat answers `409 idempotency_in_progress` (retry after a moment). The same key with a different method, path or body answers `422 idempotency_key_reused`. Only 2xx and 4xx answers are stored; after a 5xx the key is released so you can retry. Keys are per API key and kept for 24 hours; a stored body above 64 KB is not kept (the status is replayed with `{}`). A write refused for a read-only (`pk_test_`) key is refused before idempotency and stores nothing.

**Conditional requests.** `GET` of one record, reference or refund returns a strong `ETag`. Send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified` when nothing changed, or as `If-Match` on `PATCH` to change the resource only if it is still the version you read (`412 precondition_failed` otherwise, nothing is changed). `If-Match` is optional; without it a `PATCH` applies as before.

**Isolation.** A record, reference or refund of another brand, or a record or refund of the other environment, answers `404 not_found`, never 403.

**Refunds.** PODFY records refund requests from the report form and never pays them out. A brand admin (in the portal) or your system (`POST /refunds/{id}/approve`) approves a request; PODFY then sends the signed webhook `refund.approved` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name. Your payment platform pays and reports back with `POST /refunds/{id}/result`. Use the refund `id` as the idempotency key: sending the same result again answers the same refund and changes nothing.

**Paging.** List endpoints return `{data, next_cursor}`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until it is `null`. Records are newest first. Cursors are opaque.

**Errors.** Every error is JSON `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}}` with `code` one of a fixed list (the `Error` schema). Use `code` for logic and `message` for people. Several causes share a code (all malformed requests are `invalid_request`, all state conflicts `conflict`); the optional `detail` then names the specific reason (for example `ref_exists`, `invalid_transition`, `invalid_cursor`, `comment_too_long`) and is absent when there is nothing more specific. `detail` is an open list. Unexpected failures answer `500 internal_error` without details. A method the endpoint does not serve answers `405 method_not_allowed` with an `Allow` header; a body above 16 KB answers `413 payload_too_large`. Responses are never cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`). No CORS: call the API from your server, never from a browser.

**Webhooks.** PODFY can also push events to your server; see the `webhooks` section of this document for every event, its payload and how to verify the signature.

tags.description: The reference (asset) register; requires the asset register to be active

tags.name: Refunds

get.description:
Records of your brand, newest first. Deleted records are never listed.

Required scope: `records:read` (a key with `records:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only records created at or after this moment (ISO 8601 date or date-time; a time without zone is UTC).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only records changed (or created) at or after this moment (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Work status, one or more comma separated.

200.description: The page of records, newest first.

get.description:
One record with its timeline (`created`, `status`, `comment`, `assign`, `priority`, `duplicate`). Mail recipients and reporter data never appear.

Required scope: `records:read` (a key with `records:write` may also call it).

patch.description:
Change the work status, assignee or priority, or add a comment. Same rules as the portal: one timeline event per change, webhooks `record.status_changed` / `record.updated` are sent, the actor is `api:<key prefix>`. Needs status tracking (report mode or the status tracking add-on), else `403 feature_not_active`. Only the fields below are accepted. Send `If-Match` with the `ETag` of your last `GET` to refuse the change when the record changed meanwhile (`412 precondition_failed`).

Required scope: `records:write`.

200.description: The record after the update. `changed` is false when nothing differed. `ETag` is the new version.

get.description:
Your reference register, ordered by ref.

Required scope: `references:read` (a key with `references:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text contained in ref, name or location (1–100 characters).

post.description:
Adds one reference. `409 conflict` when the ref is already in the register.

Required scope: `references:write`. QA keys (pk_test_) cannot change references: the register is shared with production records (403 insufficient_scope).

get.description:
One reference.

Required scope: `references:read` (a key with `references:write` may also call it).

patch.description:
Edit, move, retire (`status: retired`) or reactivate a reference. Only the fields below are accepted; an empty string clears a text field.

Required scope: `references:write`. QA keys (pk_test_) cannot change references: the register is shared with production records (403 insufficient_scope).

Send `If-Match` with the `ETag` of your last `GET` to refuse the change when the reference changed meanwhile (`412 precondition_failed`).

200.description: The reference after the update. `changed` is false when nothing differed. `ETag` is the new version.

get.description:
Refund requests of the brand, newest first.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:read` (a key with `refunds:write` may also call it).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Refund status, one or more comma separated.

200.description: The page of refunds, newest first.

get.description:
One refund request.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:read` (a key with `refunds:write` may also call it).

post.description:
Moves a `requested` refund to `approved` (actor `api:<key prefix>`). Sends the webhook `refund.approved` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name (never to `*`). Any other status: `409 conflict`. The body is optional.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

Moves a `requested` refund to `rejected` (actor `api:<key prefix>`). Sends the webhook `refund.updated` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name (never to `*`). Any other status: `409 conflict`. The body is optional.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

Your payment platform reports the result of an `approved` refund: `paid` or `failed`. Sends the webhook `refund.updated` to webhooks that subscribed to it by name. Idempotent: the same status again answers `200` with the stored refund and changes nothing. A result for a refund that is not approved (or a different result after a final one): `409 conflict`.

Needs refund requests active for the brand (part of Advanced), else `403 feature_not_active`. `pk_test_…` keys see and change only refunds of QA records, `pk_live_…` keys only production refunds; anything else answers `404 not_found`.

Required scope: `refunds:write`.

200.description: The refund after the change (or unchanged for a repeat of the same result).

post.summary: A proof of delivery was uploaded
post.description: Sent for every new record of a brand in delivery mode. Subscribe with `pod.created` or `*`.

parameters.name: Podfy-Event
parameters.description: The event name, as in the body.

2XX.description: Any 2xx answer acknowledges the delivery. Other answers, timeouts and network errors are retried with increasing delays; redirects are not followed. Answer quickly and process afterwards.

PODFY never pays out. `record.refund` carries the refund; use `record.refund.id` as your idempotency key. The approver's e-mail is not included.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: pk_live_… / pk_test_… (40 hex characters after the prefix)
bearerAuth.description: API key from Settings → Integrations → API keys.

podfy_id.name: podfy_id
podfy_id.description: The record's PODFY ID, e.g. PFY-7Q4K2-1 (QA-… for test records).

ref.name: ref
ref.description: The reference (1–64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen).

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page size, 1–200 (default 50; larger values are capped at 200).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, unique per request you intend. The same key with the same request replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request answers `422 idempotency_key_reused`. Kept 24 hours per API key.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `ETag` of the version you read. When the resource changed since, the answer is `412 precondition_failed` and nothing is changed. `*` matches any existing resource. Optional.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: The `ETag` you already have. When it is still current the answer is `304 Not Modified` without a body.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key (600).

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time (seconds) when the current window ends.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the request may be retried (the next rate-limit window, or the moment a running idempotent request is expected to be done).

ETag.description: Strong validator of the resource (changes with every write). Send it back as `If-None-Match` (GET) or `If-Match` (PATCH).

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this answer is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`; nothing was executed again.

Podfy-Signature.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>,v2=<hex>`. `v1` = HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of `<t>.<raw body>` with your webhook secret; `v2` = HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of `<t>.<Podfy-Delivery>.<raw body>`, so a captured request cannot be replayed under another delivery id. During a secret rotation (24 hours) a second `v1`/`v2` pair signed with the previous secret follows: accept the request when any pair matches. Compare in constant time and reject a `t` more than 5 minutes from your clock.

Podfy-Delivery.description: Unique id of this delivery (`dlv_…`); a retry of the same delivery carries the same id. Use it to de-duplicate.

BadRequest.description: The request is not valid: an unknown or malformed query parameter, cursor, body field or `Idempotency-Key`; the `message` names it and `detail` (when present) gives the specific reason, e.g. `invalid_cursor` or `comment_too_long`. Code: `invalid_request`.

error.message: limit: must be a whole number from 1 to 200
Unknown field: owner. Allowed: ref, name, location, group_code, sticker_text.
cursor: not a cursor returned by this API
comment is too long.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked (always the same body). Code: `invalid_key`.

error.message: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The Open API (or, for references, the reference register; for record updates, status tracking; for refunds, refund requests) is not active for the brand, the key lacks the scope, or a `pk_test_` key tried to change references. Codes: `feature_not_active`, `insufficient_scope`, `read_only_key`.

error.message: This API key does not have the records:write scope.
The reference register is not active for this brand.
QA API keys (pk_test_) cannot change references.

NotFound.description: No such endpoint, or no such record / reference / refund for this key's brand and environment. Code: `not_found`.

error.message: Record not found.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The endpoint exists but not with this method; `Allow` lists the methods it serves. Code: `method_not_allowed`.

error.message: Use GET.

Conflict.description: The reference already exists (`detail`: `ref_exists`), or a repeat of the request is still running. Codes: `conflict`, `idempotency_in_progress`.

error.message: A reference with this ref already exists.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry shortly.

RateLimited.description: More than 600 requests in this minute for this key, or more than 1200 per IP address (checked before the key). Code: `rate_limited`.

error.message: Rate limit of 600 requests per minute exceeded.
Too many requests from this IP address (limit 1200 per minute).

ServerError.description: Unexpected error; no details are given. Try again later. Code: `internal_error`.

error.message: Something went wrong. Try again later.

RefundConflict.description: The refund is not in a status that allows this change (requested → approved | rejected; approved → paid | failed), (`detail`: `invalid_transition`), or a repeat of the request is still running. Codes: `conflict`, `idempotency_in_progress`.

error.message: This refund cannot make that change in its current status (requested → approved | rejected; approved → paid | failed).
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry shortly.

IdempotencyInProgress.description: A request with this `Idempotency-Key` is still being processed. Retry after a moment with the same key. Code: `idempotency_in_progress`.

error.message: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry shortly.

PreconditionFailed.description: `If-Match` does not match the current `ETag`: the resource changed since you read it. Nothing was changed; GET it again and retry. Code: `precondition_failed`.

error.message: The resource changed since the ETag in If-Match was issued. GET it again and retry.
Send a JSON body with Content-Type: application/json.

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: This `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different method, path or body. Code: `idempotency_key_reused`.

error.message: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request.

NotModified.description: The `ETag` in `If-None-Match` is still current; no body.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than 16 KB. Code: `payload_too_large`.

error.message: The body is larger than 16 KB.

code.description: Machine-readable code. `invalid_key`: 401. The API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked. `feature_not_active`: 403. The Open API, or the feature behind the endpoint (reference register, status tracking, refund requests), is not active for the brand. `insufficient_scope`: 403. The key lacks the scope the endpoint needs. `not_found`: 404. No such endpoint, or no such record, reference or refund for this key's brand and environment. `method_not_allowed`: 405. The endpoint does not serve this method; `Allow` lists the ones it does. `payload_too_large`: 413. The body is larger than 16 KB. `rate_limited`: 429. Too many requests for this key or from this IP address; see `Retry-After`. `invalid_request`: 400. The query parameter, cursor, body or `Idempotency-Key` is not valid (the message names it). `conflict`: 409. The request conflicts with the current state: the reference already exists, or a refund is not in a status that allows the change. `read_only_key`: 403. A `pk_test_` (QA) key tried to change production data (references). `precondition_failed`: 412. `If-Match` does not match the current `ETag`; nothing was changed. `idempotency_key_reused`: 422. This `Idempotency-Key` was used for a different method, path or body. `idempotency_in_progress`: 409. A request with this `Idempotency-Key` is still running. `unsupported_media_type`: 415. A `POST` or `PATCH` body must be `application/json`. `internal_error`: 500. Unexpected failure; no details are given. Retry later (an `Idempotency-Key` is released after a 5xx).

message.description: For people; names the detail. Do not parse it (use `code` and `detail`).

detail.description: Optional, an open list: the specific reason behind a general `code`, so you can branch on it. Absent when there is nothing more specific. New values may appear without notice, so treat an unknown one like no detail. Known values: `invalid_parameter`, `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_body`, `invalid_status`, `invalid_priority`, `invalid_assignee`, `invalid_comment`, `comment_too_long`, `nothing_to_update`, `record_has_duplicates`, `invalid_ref`, `ref_exists`, `name_too_long`, `location_too_long`, `group_code_too_long`, `sticker_text_too_long`, `no_valid_fields`, `invalid_transition`, `invalid_note`, `note_too_long`, `invalid_platform_ref`, `platform_ref_too_long`, `duplicate_pay_ref`.

error.message: This API key does not have the records:write scope.

Record.description: The same record object as in webhook payloads, plus timestamps and the assignee.

category.description: Category code (report mode) or delivery issue code.

group_id.description: Records of one multi-file upload share it (the podfy_id without the -N suffix).

duplicate_of.description: podfy_id of the first report this one duplicates.

url.description: Public detail page of the record.

assignee.description: E-mail of the assigned brand member.

keep_informed.description: True when the reporter asked to be kept informed (a confirmation or resolved message was or can be sent). Never the address.

assignee.description: An active member of the brand, or null to unassign.

id.description: Refund id; use it as the idempotency key.

result.description: Set once the platform reported paid or failed.

podfy_id.description: The record the refund belongs to.

flags.description: e.g. `duplicate_pay_ref` (the payment reference was used by another request of this brand).

decided_by.description: Who approved or rejected: a portal user's e-mail, `auto`, or `api:<key prefix>`.

updated_at.description: Last change of the refund (also drives the `ETag`).

note.description: Optional note (stored with the refund, never sent in webhooks).

WebhookRefund.description: `record.refund` of `refund.approved` / `refund.updated`. The approver's e-mail is never included. Use `id` as your idempotency key.

WebhookRecord.description: The record at the time of the event. The same object as `Record` in the API without `assignee`, `created_at`, `resolved_at` and `keep_informed`.

updated_at.description: Last change of the record; for a created event the event time. Compare it to drop out-of-order deliveries.

WebhookPayload.description: The JSON body of every standard webhook. (Webhooks configured with a custom payload template send your own body instead; the signature and headers are the same.) New fields may be added without a `version` change; `version` is bumped only for a breaking change.
